meta.name: market-landscape-scan
meta.description: Map a market's segments, players, substitutes, and whitespace with cited evidence. Use when entering or re-evaluating a market before sizing, positioning, or picking competitors to study.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 绘制市场格局，识别细分、玩家与空白机会
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在进入或重新评估一个市场，需要结构化全景图
copy.tagline_en: Map market segments, players, substitutes, and whitespace with evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are entering or re-evaluating a market and need a structured landscape overview

howto.what: 它会按固定流程扫描一个市场:先列出搜索计划,再按买家真实体验划分市场段,标出直接对手、相邻玩家、替代品和新兴者,分析资金与动向,最后检验空白区域是机会还是死区,产出带证据引用的《市场格局快照》,并把事实、推断和假设分开标注。
howto.when: 当你想进入或重新评估某个市场,或要求梳理某领域的玩家、空白和替代品时触发。例如:“帮我扫描一下合同分析工具市场”。

say.text: 帮我扫描一下合同分析工具市场,支持进入决策。
say.note: 输出市场格局快照,含玩家和空白。

say.text: 梳理开发者API可观测性工具的市场格局,限定欧洲。
重新评估我们的定位,先画出这个市场的分段和替代品。
say.note: 它会从买家视角分段并标出非消费替代。

howto.what_en: Runs a structured market scan: search plan -> buyer-view segmentation -> player map (direct, adjacent, substitutes, emerging) -> dynamics (money, momentum) -> whitespace vs dead-zone check. Produces a Market Landscape Snapshot with cited evidence and Fact/Inference/Assumption labels.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to map a market before entering or re-evaluating it, e.g. 'scan the contract-analytics tooling market', or when you request competitor/whitespace mapping for a decision.

say_en.text: Scan the contract-analytics tooling market to support an entry decision.
say_en.note: Returns a landscape snapshot with players and whitespace.

say_en.text: Map developer-facing API observability tools, EU only.
Re-evaluate our positioning; sketch segments and substitutes first.
say_en.note: Uses buyer view to segment and flags non-consumption.
